slides.texte_overlay:
hobbies that will make you
dangerously confident

window watching

sit by a window for 15 minutes and watch strangers walk past, no phone. you start noticing how little anyone is thinking about you, and the relief lands in your body.

first word rule

in every room you walk into this week, be the first to say hello. the first word costs nothing, and it quietly decides who sets the tone.

silent commute

do your commute with no music, no podcast, no scrolling. whatever your mind brings up in those 20 minutes is what you've been drowning out all day.

random expertise

spend 5 minutes a day learning something you'll never need: a forgotten empire, a strange painting, how octopuses think. having something to say in any room changes how you walk into it.

finished things

finish one small thing every day before noon, even making your bed properly. confidence is just a pile of evidence that you do what you say.
